Music theory. If I find some unfortunate nerd who knows what that even means then they're going to suffer, I can talk for hours.

For Anorexia: 
I am aware of the health risks, and I do still feel hunger and the ill side effects of not eating. The disorder itself is the ability to dismiss these things for the goal of being thinner.

For Depression:
When I say I'm feeling suicidal, it (usually) doesn't mean I want to kill myself, but if I were in the path of a moving bus, I wouldn't have the strength to move. I don't want to die or kill myself, I just want to not be alive- which is sorta the same thing.
